text:
Eine inständige Bitte erlaube ich mir mit den anliegenden
Acten bey derselben Behändigung an den H. Criminal in
Grimm, daß Sie selbst mit ihm über folgenden Umstand
sprechen möchten.
Es werden diesen Wittowes Acten schon lange in der Trąbczyner
Registratur gesucht, wo ich selbst gemeint und behaubtet habe.
Es sind aber solche beym Ausziehen
daß sie liegen würden.
von meinem Logis zu Breſslau nach Wilhelmsruh unter den
Pappieren meiner Frau gefunden worden, weil diese Acten in
einer Zeit wo ich von Breschlau abwesend gewesen bin von meiner
Frau in Empfang genommen, und zur sichern Verwahrung unter
ihre Sachen gelegt worden sind, wo die Pappiere nie gelesen
werden, und somit mir nachher zuzustellen vergeßen worden
sind

I permit myself an urgent request, together with the enclosed files, upon their delivery to the criminal-court councillor in Grimm, that you yourself might speak with him concerning the following circumstance.

These Witów files have long been sought in the registry at Trąbczyn, where I myself supposed and maintained [that they would be lying]. They were, however, upon my moving out

that they would be lying.

from my lodgings at Breslau to Wilhelmsruh, found among the papers of my wife, because these files were received by my wife at a time when I was absent from Breslau, and were laid for safe keeping among her belongings, where the papers are never read, and thus it was forgotten to hand them over to me afterwards.

text_english:
I permit myself an urgent request, together with the enclosed files, upon their delivery to the criminal-court councillor in Grimm, that you yourself might speak with him concerning the following circumstance.

These Witów files have long been sought in the registry at Trąbczyn, where I myself supposed and maintained [that they would be lying]. They were, however, upon my moving out

that they would be lying.

from my lodgings at Breslau to Wilhelmsruh, found among the papers of my wife, because these files were received by my wife at a time when I was absent from Breslau, and were laid for safe keeping among her belongings, where the papers are never read, and thus it was forgotten to hand them over to me afterwards.
summary_en: A covering note sending on the long-missing Witów files, with an urgent request that the recipient speak in person to the criminal-court councillor in Grimm about the matter. The writer explains that the papers had been searched for in vain in the registry at Trąbczyn, where he himself believed them to be, and only came to light on his move from his Breslau lodgings to Wilhelmsruh, among his wife's belongings, she having received them in his absence and forgotten to pass them on.
summary_de: Begleitschreiben zu übersandten Akten: Der Verfasser bittet dringend, die beiliegenden Witów-Akten dem Kriminalgerichtsrat in Grimm zu übergeben und mit ihm persönlich über den Vorgang zu sprechen. Die Akten seien lange in der Registratur zu Trąbczyn vermutet und gesucht worden; erst beim Umzug aus der Breslauer Wohnung nach Wilhelmsruh habe man sie unter den Papieren seiner Frau gefunden, die sie in seiner Abwesenheit erhalten, verwahrt und danach zu übergeben vergessen habe.
